    f.nicklabel AS nickname,
    f.ptsval AS contribution_score,
    jsonb_extract_path_text(sc.community_engagement, 'group_involvement', 'grprole') AS group_role,
    e.actfreq AS activity_frequency,
    ms.membdays AS membership_duration
FROM 
    fans f

    socialcommunity sc ON f.userregistry = sc.socialreg
JOIN 
    engagement e ON sc.socialengagepivot = e.engagereg

    membershipandspending ms ON f.userregistry = ms.memberfanpivot

SELECT 
    f.nicklabel AS nickname,
    f.ptsval AS contribution_score,
    jsonb_extract_path_text(sc.community_engagement, 'group_involvement', 'grprole') AS group_role,
    e.actfreq AS activity_frequency,
    ms.membdays AS membership_duration
FROM 
    fans f
JOIN 
    socialcommunity sc ON f.userregistry = sc.socialreg
JOIN 
    engagement e ON sc.socialengagepivot = e.engagereg
JOIN 
    membershipandspending ms ON f.userregistry = ms.memberfanpivot
ORDER BY 
    f.ptsval DESC;

SELECT 
    f.nicklabel AS nickname,
    f.ptsval AS contribution_score,
    jsonb_extract_path_text(sc.community_engagement, 'group_involvement', 'grprole') AS group_role,
    e.actfreq AS activity_frequency,
    ms.membdays AS membership_duration
FROM 
    fans f
JOIN 
    membershipandspending ms ON f.userregistry = ms.memberfanpivot
JOIN 
    engagement e ON ms.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
JOIN 
    socialcommunity sc ON e.engagereg = sc.socialengagepivot
ORDER BY 
    f.ptsval DESC;
